description: This PHP source file defines the IDGeneratorService class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides methods for generating sequential IDs with specific prefixes for various entity types such as Location, JobCategory, JobTitle, Membership, and Employee. It manages ID incrementation, retrieval, and prefix assignment based on entity class, utilizing DAO pattern for database operations and traits for helper functions.

classes.name: IDGeneratorService
classes.description: A service class responsible for generating and managing unique IDs for various entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to get the next sequential ID with specific prefixes, retrieve current IDs, and increment IDs, often interacting with the database through DAO.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorDao
methods.description: Returns the Data Access Object responsible for interacting with the ID generator data in the database. Initializes the DAO if not already set.

methods.name: setIDGeneratorDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO object used for database operations related to ID generation.

methods.name: getEntityPrefix
methods.description: Determines the prefix string based on the entity class provided, which is used in ID formatting.

methods.name: getNextID
methods.description: Generates and optionally updates the next ID for a specified entity class, returning it with the appropriate prefix and zero-padding.

methods.name: incrementId
methods.description: Increments the ID counter for a given entity class in the database.
